meta.name: Aur Bhai Kya Chal Raha Hai
meta.description: Hindi Tv Show that is about a brother and sister who take on their parents

videos.title: Pappu and Bittu's Plan
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina make Mishra and Mirza do the house work. Pappu and Bittu tell Mishra and Mirza to build a mall there to save the mansion. Later, both of them trick Sakina and Shanti into their plan.

videos.title: Banke Bulldozer Arrives at the Mansion
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza share the ownership of the mansion to avoid punishment. Later, their families agree to build a mall in place of the mansion. The demolished department's Banke arrives home.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Unite to Save the Mansion
videos.overview: Banke inspects the mansion. Shanti and Sakina prepare to move to a new house. Eventually, Mishra and Mirza reveal the truth to their families. Later, everyone tries to turn Pappu against Bittu.

videos.title: An Electricity Pole to be Installed
videos.overview: Paro gossips with Shanti and Sakina. Everyone learns about the expected installation of an electricity pole. Shanti and Sakina insist Mishra and Mirza to get it installed in front of their house.

videos.title: Where Will the Electricity Pole Be Installed?
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina get their husbands to do the household chores. A power outage worries everyone in the mansion. Mirza and Mishra learn where the new electricity pole will be installed.

videos.title: Mirza and Mishra Bribe an Engineer
videos.overview: Mirza and Mishra bribe an engineer to not install an electricity pole before their house. Even others in the locality disallow its installation. Later, Paro gives Shanti and Sakina a piece of news.

videos.title: The Place for Pole Gets Finalised
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina insist their husbands to get an electricity pole installed in front of the house for money. Mishra and Mirza struggle to get it done. An engineer decides a place for it.

videos.title: The End of an Electricity Pole Dispute
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina refuse to share the compensation amount. After the electricity pole gets installed, the two families quarrel over the money. Later, they decide to give it to a needy person.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza's New Problem
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina try to prove each other's cooking superior. Mishra and Mirza eat each other's food and praise it after returning home. Their wives refuse to give them homemade food as a punishment.

videos.title: A Competition between Sakina and Shanti
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza try to hide their condition from each other. Mirza suggests Mishra an idea to solve the problem. Sakina and Shanti cook for Bittu and Pappu to prove themselves better than each other.

videos.title: Sakina and Shanti Leave Home
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza eat the food prepared for a competition. They resort to cheating to avoid getting caught. Later, they get exposed and their wives leave their house out of anger.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza's Plan
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza try unsuccessfully to look after children. Later, they devise a plan along with a doctor. A disguised doctor arrives at the mansion and Paro apprises Sakina and Shanti of this.

videos.title: Shanti and Sakina's Homecoming
videos.overview: Paro calls Shanti and Sakina as her job is at risk because of Jalebi and Imarti. They both return home and Mishra and Mirza make them realise that they got late in returning home.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza's Celebration Event
videos.overview: The book of rights and duties of the mansion states that there will be a celebration in the mansion, but the fraudsters will be forbidden. Mishra and Mirza organise it, but Bittu is not included.

videos.title: A Ghost in the Mansion
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina fire Paro. Bittu joins Paro and a doctor in their plan to take revenge on the people of the mansion. Later, all three work on the plan to scare the mansion owners.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Seek Bittu's Help
videos.overview: Paro and a doctor continue to frighten the people of the mansion. Mishra and Mirza ask Bittu for help. Bittu works on his plan to get a tantric to oust Mishra and Mirza from the mansion.

videos.title: The Ghost of the Mansion
videos.overview: At night, Mirza and Mishra's families feel terrified to step out of the room due to a ghost. Later, they decide to confront the ghost and give it food. Eventually, the ghost is exposed.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Teach Bittu a Lesson
videos.overview: Paro and a doctor tell the Mishras and Mirzas about Bittu's ploy. Mishra and Mirza call Bittu at the mansion by pretending to hand it over to him. Later, both the families teach Bittu a lesson.

videos.title: Shanti and Sakina Want a Smart TV
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza's TVs turn faulty. Shanti and Sakina refuse to give those TVs to junk buyers. Later, they insist their husbands to buy smart TV when Paro brings home a smart TV.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza buy Smart TVs
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza tell Bittu about their wives' demands. Both of them try to hide about buying a TV from each other. Later, Mishra and Mirza buy smart TVs at a low price.

videos.title: Mirza and Mishra's TV Woes
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza try to switch on their new and cheap smart TVs. However, it troubles them a lot. The shopkeeper's running away adds to their difficulties. Bittu feels happy with what he has done.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza's Problems
videos.overview: Bittu tells Mishra and Mirza a scheme of replacing their old TVs with the new ones. They convince their wives and increase their problems. Later, they learn the truth about Paro's TV.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza's Plan for TVs
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza buy brooms of the entire city to win TV in a lucky draw. However, a salesman scolds them. Later, they try a plan to get the TVs. Will Mishra and Mirza get TVs?

videos.title: Shanti and Sakina's Wish
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina insist their husbands to travel abroad. They allow Paro a leave and get their husbands to do the household chores, which forces them to agree. A man in the market overhears them.

videos.title: Prakash Tricks Everyone
videos.overview: Prakash meets Mishra and Mirza and they fall for his explanation. The list of their wives' travel abroad shocks Mishra and Mirza. Even Shanti and Sakina get impressed by Prakash's lucrative offer.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Thrash Prakash
videos.overview: The Mishras and the Mirzas learn Prakash's western mannerisms. A journalist's words shock Mishra and Mirza. Later, they both thrash Prakash. Bittu tells Shanti and Sakina about this.

videos.title: Mishra's and Mirza's Apology
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza apologise to Prakash and mollify him. Later, Mishra and Mirza seek help from Bittu for their passport. Bittu makes his next move against Mishra and Mirza.

videos.title: Prakash and Bittu Get Exposed
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza learn about Prakash and Bittu's ploy. They both decide to jointly teach them a lesson. They first call them at the mansion and extract their money and then execute their next plan.

videos.title: Shanti's Great Grandfather's Photo
videos.overview: The people of the mansion go out and they have to stay in the same house. Shanti hangs her great grandfather's photo in the house. Bittu executes his plan to turn the Mishras against the Mirzas.

videos.title: Mishra and Bachchan's Challenge
videos.overview: Mishra and Bachchan challenge each other to get ousted and the mansion is at stake. Shanti and Sakina lure Paro into working in their houses. Later, the matter gets even more serious.

videos.title: Mirza and Bachchan Patch Up
videos.overview: Chintu and Pistolia turn out to be estranged brothers, which foils Bittu's plan. Mirza and Bachchan quit their decision to oust each other from the house before Eid and come to a new agreement.

videos.title: A Jeweller Dupes Bachchan
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina argue over a tailor, Jumman Miyan. Sampath, a jeweller, flees with Bachchan's money. Bittu apprises Mirza of this. Bachchan feels worried about celebrating Eid without money.

videos.title: The Mishras and the Mirzas' Eid
videos.overview: Bachchan hesitates to take Shanti to the bazaar due to losing money. He later learns that Mirza had sent money to Shanti with Guddu. Mirza and Bachchan embrace each other and celebrate Eid together.

videos.title: Bittu and Pappu’s New Plan
videos.overview: In order to capture the entire mansion, Bittu and Pappu keep the members of the mansion engaged in acting assignments. They later put their plan in action, and everyone gives auditions for a movie.

videos.title: Bittu Turns against Pappu
videos.overview: Director Ghai stops the shoot due to being fed up with everyone's poor acting. Mirza and Bachchan turn Bittu and Pappu against each other. Bittu vows to snatch the role of a villain from Bachchan.

videos.title: Pappu Gets the Villain's Role
videos.overview: Pappu reminds Bittu of his true motive and tries to pacify him. At Pappu's request, director Ghai resumes shooting. Later, he chooses Pappu over Bachchan for the role of a villain.

videos.title: Mirza and Doctor's Pretence
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina feel happy when the shooting begins. Bachchan shares his grief with Shanti, Sakina and Mirza. Later, Mirza takes Doctor's help to begin a pretence in front of director Ghai.	Shanti and Sakina feel happy when the shooting begins. Bachchan shares his grief with Shanti, Sakina and Mirza. Later, Mirza takes Doctor's help to begin a pretence in front of director Ghai.

videos.title: Will the Shooting Be Completed?
videos.overview: Bittu stops a film's shooting after hearing Ghai, but Pappu helps resume it. Bittu and Pappu's plan to usurp the mansion gets foiled again. Bittu and Doctor begin a new pretence in front of Ghai.

videos.title: Mirza and Bachchan in Trouble
videos.overview: Mirza and Bachchan clean the house. A man visits them and a mishap takes place. Mirza and Bachchan try to hide that man's corpse from everyone. Later, Bahubali's wife Basanti phones Bittu.

videos.title: Shanti and Sakina's Misunderstanding
videos.overview: Mirza is horrified to see a corpse disappear from an almirah and Bachchan reveals the truth. Bachchan has to sleep with the corpse to avoid being exposed. Sakina and Shanti develop a misunderstanding.

videos.title: Mirza and Bachchan's Revelation
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina try to learn the truth from Bachchan and Mirza. Basanti's words frighten Bittu. When Mirza and Bachchan's families ask them to reveal the truth, they oblige.

videos.title: Dr Koodelal Agrees to Spy
videos.overview: Shanti informs Bittu and Pappu about lying to Paro. Bittu asks Dr Koodelal to spy on the people of the mansion. Mirza and Bachchan follow Bittu and Pappu on seeing them leave with a corpse.

videos.title: Bachchan Wins Everyone's Heart
videos.overview: Bittu, Pappu and Mirza suspect Bachchan of fleeing with the corpse, so everyone curses him. He hands over Basanti's husband to her safely. Later, his revelation wins everyone's heart.

videos.title: Bachchan and Mirza Need Money
videos.overview: Bachchan convinces Mirza to try his hand at lottery to earn quick money. They buy a lottery ticket together. Bittu and Pappu try to use the opportunity to their advantage by tricking them.

videos.title: Bachchan and Mirza Try Betting
videos.overview: Mirza and Bachchan fall prey to Bittu and Pappu's plan. Bittu and Pappu convince Mirza and Bachchan to try betting on a match. Later, Mirza and Bachchan lie to Sakina and Shanti about their work.

videos.title: Bachchan and Mirza Place Big Bets
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina suspect Bachchan and Mirza. Bittu and Pappu lure Mirza and Bachchan into placing bigger bets. They give INR five lakhs to Pappu and Bittu each, but they both lose the money.

videos.title: Mirza and Bachchan Take a Huge Risk
videos.overview: Mirza and Bachchan share their grief with each other. Bittu asks them to try their luck again to make up for their loss. They borrow a loan from Cobra Don and lose the money again in betting.

videos.title: Bittu and Pappu Get Cheated
videos.overview: Bachchan and Mirza learn that Bittu and Pappu have cheated them. Cobra Don gives Bachchan and Mirza some time to return the money. Babuji's trick to extract money from Bittu and Pappu succeeds.

videos.title: Mirza And Bachchan Like Chaka Chak
videos.overview: Bachchan learns about a company named Chaka Chak and decides to do network marketing. He informs Mirza as well and Mirza is very interested in a product named Chaka Chak.

videos.title: Bittu Fools Mirza
videos.overview: Mirza and Bachchan entrust Sakina and Shanti with the task to add new members. Mirza explains the plan to Bittu too, who borrows INR 5,000 from him. Even Pappu becomes a member without paying.

videos.title: Chaka Chak Worries Mirza and Bachchan
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina shoot Bachchan and Mirza's videos for marketing. Mirza and Bachchan decide to get rid of Chaka Chak. Shanti and Sakina fall for Bittu and Pappu's ploy to get new members.

videos.title: Bachchan and Mirza Land in Trouble
videos.overview: Bachchan and Mirza give demos of Chaka Chak but no one shows interest in becoming a member. They both learn about Bittu and Pappu's ploy. Later, some news shocks Shanti, Sakina, Mirza and Bachchan.

videos.title: Bittu Falls for Mirza's Ploy
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina ask Mirza and Bachchan to fix everything soon. Mirza hatches a ploy and Bittu falls for it due to his greed. Later, Bittu learns about the bankruptcy of 'Bech De' company.

videos.title: Mishra's Health Checkup
videos.overview: Bachchan tries to cheer up Mishra. Mirza and Mishra are excited to meet each other. Mirza and Mishra learn about a free health checkup. Later, Saudagar begins Mishra's checkup.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza's Routine Changes
videos.overview: Saudagar asks Mishra and Mirza to change their diet and begin exercising. He advises them to get insured. Shanti and Sakina bring changes in Mishra and Mirza's routine and Bachchan helps them.

videos.title: Aur Bhai Kya Chal Raha Hai - June 16, 2021
videos.overview: Now, viewers in India can watch Aur Bhai Kya Chal Raha Hai episodes before their TV telecast on ZEE5! Aur Bhai Kya Chal Raha Hai is a Hindi sitcom showcasing the lives of the Mishras and Mirzas, living in the same haveli. The show focusses on both the families’ desire to gain complete ownership of the haveli and the funny situations that ensue.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Get Exposed
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza eat junk food at Bittu and Pappu's insistence. Bachchan tells Mishra's and Mirza's family about it. Mishra and Mirza realise their mistake. Later, Saudagar makes a revelation.

videos.title: Mirza and Sakina's Viral Video
videos.overview: Mirza and Sakina's video goes viral on Tuk Tuk because of their son, Inaam. They decide to shoot more videos. Mishra advises Shanti to not fall for the idea of making videos, but in vain.

videos.title: Shanti Makes a Video with Mishra
videos.overview: Mirza's popularity takes Mishra by surprise. Paro advises Shanti to make a video of beating Mishra. After learning about this, even Sakina desires to make a similar video with Mirza.

videos.title: Tuk Tuk Bothers Mishra and Mirza
videos.overview: Mirza asks Mishra for his help. Bittu and Pappu start a campaign against Tuk Tuk. Shanti and Sakina enter a competition against each other. Bittu and Pappu try unsuccessfully to help Mishra and Mirza.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza in Trouble
videos.overview: Bittu and Pappu refuse to help Mishra and Mirza. Mirza and Mishra land into new trouble while trying to get rid of Tuk Tuk. Shanti and Sakina learn about their husbands' lies.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Get a Scolding
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina lash out at Mishra and Mirza. Later, Mishra and Mirza execute Mirza's plan to get rid of Tuk Tuk. Consequently, Shanti and Sakina take a decision for the sake of the children.

videos.title: Mirza and Mishra Get Electrocuted
videos.overview: Mirza and Mishra are shocked to see the electricity bill. Pappu and Bittu suggest Mirza and Mishra to steal electricity. However, Mirza and Mishra get electrocuted while doing so.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Caught Red-handed
videos.overview: Officer Imaandar catches Mishra and Mirza in the act of theft. The power of the mansion is cut off. Later, only one meter gets installed. Bittu and Pappu try creating a rift between Mishra and Mirza.

videos.title: Paro Provokes Shanti and Sakina
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza keep an eye on each other and control the use of electricity. Bittu and Pappu try to create a rift between Mishra and Mirza. Soon, Paro provokes Shanti and Sakina.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Get Greedy
videos.overview: A fight breaks out between the Mishras and Mirzas and they begin wasting electricity. Bittu and Pappu trick Mishra and Mirza and give free electricity to the people. Soon arrives an electricity bill.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza's Pretence
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza learn about Bittu and Pappu's deceit. The Mishras and Mirzas pretend to be poor to get the electricity bill waived off. Later, Bittu and Pappu bear the brunt of their misdeeds.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Buy a Car
videos.overview: After seeing Paro's car, Shanti and Sakina demand cars from their husbands. Mishra and Mirza seek help from Bittu. Later, they get a car home but a misunderstanding leads to a huge mishap.

videos.title: Both Families Fight to Claim the Car
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza reveal that the car belongs to both families. Bittu and Pappu take the car for a drive, but the mango seller recognises it. An incident in the night puts everyone in a fix.

videos.title: Sajjan's Offer to Mishra and Mirza
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza find mangoes in the car. Chaska visits the mansion for the mangoes, but Shanti beats him up. Later, Mirza hears a sound from the mangoes. Sajjan makes an offer to Mishra and Mirza.

videos.title: Chaska Tries to Steal the Car Keys
videos.overview: Pappu and Bittu assert their authority over the car, but Mishra and Mirza do not give them the keys. Later, Chaska and Sajjan sneak into the mansion to steal the keys and get trapped there.

videos.title: Who Will Find the Diamonds?
videos.overview: Chaska points a gun at Mishra and Mirza and reveals that there were diamonds in the mangoes. Bittu and Pappu try to get them. Mishra and Mirza learn about the diamonds, but Paro brings the police.

videos.title: Masterji's Birthday
videos.overview: Mirza decides to celebrate Masterji's birthday, and Paro apprises Bittu and Pappu of this. Bittu instigates Mishra against Mirza. Later, Mishra and Mirza throw two separate parties for Masterji.

videos.title: Mishra Shares His Grief
videos.overview: After hearing Mishra's grief, Bittu suggests him to give Shanti a gift. However, Mishra's gift angers Shanti. Bittu takes Mishra to a sage. Later, Mishra raises his voice while talking to Shanti.

videos.title: A Change in Mishra Surprises Everyone
videos.overview: Mishra's changed behaviour frightens Shanti, and shocks Bittu and Pappu too. BBC and Kanta visit Bittu and Pappu. Some people's words in the bazaar anger Mishra.

videos.title: Mirza's Promise to Sakina
videos.overview: Shanti is shocked on seeing Mishra thrashing the goons, while Mirza decides to visit the sage. On learning about it, Sakina extracts a promise from Mirza. Later, Shanti gets tired of doing the chores.

videos.title: Mirza Tells Mishra about the Bracelet
videos.overview: Mishra lends his bracelet to Mirza, but it is of no use to him. Later, Mirza learns about Bittu and Pappu's conspiracy. He tells Mishra about the fake sage and the bracelet.

videos.title: Shanti Defends Mishra
videos.overview: Mirza lays down a condition in front of Mishra to hide the truth from Shanti. Mishra tries unsuccessfully to escape from the goons. He tells Shanti the truth when she defends him against the goons.

videos.title: Shanti and Sakina Make a Decision
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza get injured after fighting over a crack in the roof. Paro tells the people of the mansion about her husband. Shanti and Sakina apologise to each other and make a decision.

videos.title: How will Mishra and Mirza Reconcile?
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina ask Mishra and Mirza to reconcile. Soon, Shanti and Sakina execute the plan suggested by Masterji and Mirza's mother. Bittu and Pappu instigate Mishra and Mirza against each other.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza's Deep Friendship
videos.overview: Paro suggests Shanti and Sakina a way to reconcile Mishra and Mirza. Due to this, the two become friends, which upsets Bittu and Pappu. Later, Mishra and Mirza's friendship begins to blossom.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza's Blind Friendship
videos.overview: Bittu and Pappu, envious of Mishra and Mirza's friendship, try unsuccessfully to instigate them. Their friendship bothers Shanti and Sakina. Mishra and Mirza forget everything due to their friendship.

videos.title: The End of Mirza and Mishra's Friendship
videos.overview: Pappu and Bittu try to create a rift between Mirza and Mishra. Mirza and Mishra transfer the mansion to each other's name. However, their friendship again turns into enmity because of Pappu and Bittu.

videos.title: Shortage of Water Becomes a Problem
videos.overview: Mishra asks Mirza for water due to the shortage of water, which creates a stir. They go to get water from a government tap but return empty-handed. Later, they talk about solving this problem.

videos.title: Bittu and Pappu Turn against Each Other
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza's condition gets miserable. Bittu and Pappu use the water crisis issue against each other to become MLA. Later, Bittu meets Mirza and Sakina and Pappu meets Mishra and Shanti.

videos.title: Shanti and Sakina's Trick
videos.overview: Shanti asks Mishra to support Bittu, and Sakina asks Mirza to give Pappu money. Pappu and Bittu visit Mirza and Mishra for their respective needs. Shanti and Sakina later ask their husbands to protest.

videos.title: Mirza and Mishra to Go on a Hunger Strike
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina insist Mishra and Mirza to go on a hunger strike. Pappu and Bittu reconcile. A journalist tells Mishra and Mirza that he has published the news about their hunger strike unto death.

videos.title: Will Mishra and Mirza Protest?
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza are not given food much before the hunger strike begins. Except for them, everyone seems very excited about the protest. BBC brings a piece of news before the protest begins.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Want Modern Wives
videos.overview: Impressed by a modern Pinky, Mishra and Mirza look for faults in their wives' attire. Paro provokes Shanti and Sakina, but Pinky tells them the truth. Mishra and Mirza reveal their wishes.

videos.title: Shanti and Sakina's Modern Avatar
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina's modern avatar stuns Mishra and Mirza. Both of them take Shanti and Sakina for a bike ride. Bittu and Pappu later visit Shanti and Sakina to complain about Mishra and Mirza.

videos.title: Mirza and Mishra's Fear
videos.overview: Bittu and Pappu oppose Sakina and Shanti's decision to wear western clothes. Mirza and Mishra are afraid of their wives having an affair outside. At the bazaar, two boys fall for Sakina and Shanti.

videos.title: Sakina and Shanti's Lovers
videos.overview: Chintu and Deepu arrive at the mansion and profess their love to Sakina and Shanti. They accept their proposal to teach their husbands a lesson. Chintu and Deepu apprise Mirza and Mishra about it.

videos.title: Deepu and Chintu's Wedding Processions
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza seek help from Bittu. They realise their mistake when Shanti and Sakina reveal the truth about their pretence. Deepu and Chintu arrive at the mansion with their wedding processions.

videos.title: Bittu and Pappu Wish to Get Married
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza mock Bittu and Pappu for not being married. Bittu and Pappu seek help from Shanti and Sakina to get married. Later, Bittu commits the mistake of calling Raju.

videos.title: Bittu's and Pappu's Marriage Plans
videos.overview: While Mirza, Sakina and Raju discuss Bittu's alliance, Mishra and Shanti discuss Pappu's alliance. The wedding dates get finalised. Later, they ask Raju for tips on their first meeting with the girls.

videos.title: Bulbul and Parul's Request
videos.overview: Bulbul and Parul give Bittu and Pappu a list of their wishes. They later come up with another demand. Bittu and Pappu ask Mirza and Mishra to make lavish arrangements for the engagement and marriage.

videos.title: Bittu and Pappu in a New Trouble
videos.overview: Bittu and Pappu get engaged, and the 'Haldi' ceremony goes well too. After this, Bittu and Pappu come across a new problem. Later, they disguise as women to attend the 'Mehendi' ceremony.

videos.title: Bittu And Pappu's Fraudulent Marriage
videos.overview: Raju gets Bittu, Pappu, Mishra and Mirza to dance during 'Mehndi'. The suitress' uncle comes up with a new demand. Bittu and Pappu decide to use the pandit's remedy and do 'Kapat Shaadi'.

videos.title: Bulbul And Parul's Reality
videos.overview: Bittu and Pappu, dressed as grooms, arrive at the canopy. Bulbul and Parul's maternal uncle asks Shanti for wedding ornaments for them. Later, Bulbul, Parul and their uncle's reality shocks everyone.

videos.title: Mirza's Sister Reshma Arrives Home
videos.overview: Mishra thinks about his sister Pushpa and gets emotional. Mirza's sister Reshma arrives home and makes Sakina dance to her tunes. Later, Mishra tells Mirza why Pushpa doesn't come for Raksha Bandhan.

videos.title: Pushpa Arrives at the Mansion
videos.overview: Mirza vows to get Mishra to celebrate Rakshabandhan with Pushpa. Pushpa arrives at the mansion due to Mirza and Sakina's plan, but remains upset with Mishra and Shanti. Later, Pushpa troubles Shanti.

videos.title: Reshma's Reason for Avoiding Marriage
videos.overview: Shanti and Pushpa get emotional during a fight. Bittu and Pappu wish to marry Reshma. Mirza sees Pushpa buying a rakhi. At Mishra's request, Reshma tells him the reason for not getting married.

videos.title: Raksha Bandhan Ends Differences
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza convince Reshma to get married. After realising her mistake, Shanti apologises to Pushpa. Pushpa and Reshma tie rakhi to their brothers, and Mirza reveals his plan.

videos.title: Mishra's and Mirza's Mischievous Kids
videos.overview: The kids’ school principal visits Mishra and Mirza with a complain, but they do not take him seriously. Soon, the kids' mischief lands them in trouble. Bittu devises a new plan against them.

videos.title: The Children Get Suspended from School
videos.overview: Bittu and Pappu execute their plan. The principal visits them to reveal that he has suspended their children from school. Later, Bittu and Pappu thrash the principal and blame it on Mishra and Mirza.

videos.title: The Principal Sets a Condition
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza visit the principal on getting a letter from the school. To accept the kids back in school, the principal sets a condition. Masterji and Noorjahan devise a plan to civilise the kids.

videos.title: The Kids of the Mansion Fight Each Other
videos.overview: Mishra, Shanti, Mirza and Sakina try unsuccessfully to pacify the kids. Bittu and Pappu try to turn Mishra and Mirza against each other. Later, Mishra and Mirza's kids get into a heated scuffle.

videos.title: The Kids Compete for School Admissions
videos.overview: Masterji and Noor Jahan ask Mishra and Mirza for a sacrifice in front of their kids. Mishra and Mirza fall prey to the kids' mischief. Later, the kids compete for the school admissions.

videos.title: Sakina's Strange Dreams
videos.overview: Sakina sees a dream and the next day Mirza gets hurt. Sakina sees another strange dream and a dream expert explains it. An incident gets Mishra to feel that Sakina's dreams are coming true.

videos.title: Sakina Accepts Money to Dream
videos.overview: Sakina tells Mirza about her new dream. After a theft at Mirza's shop, he too is convinced that Sakina's dreams are coming true. Later, Sakina takes money from Shanti and Mishra for dreaming.

videos.title: Sakina's Dream Lands Masterji in Trouble
videos.overview: Sakina's strange dream lands Masterji in trouble and Shanti defends him against Lachhu Pehalwan. Later, Sakina sees another strange dream. Bittu and Pappu plan to find out about her dream.

videos.title: Is There a Treasure in the Mansion?
videos.overview: The dream expert reveals that according to Sakina's dream, there is a treasure in the mansion. Later, Bittu and Pappu ask Mirza for a share in it. A machine shows that it is in Mishra's area.

videos.title: A Sacrifice to Get the Treasure
videos.overview: Paro tells Mishra and Shanti about the treasure. A lot of people gather for their share in it. Mishra, Mirza, Shanti and Sakina set out to demolish the mansion for the treasure after finding a map.

videos.title: Mishra Faces a New Problem
videos.overview: At the bazaar, a child named Golu cuddles Mishra and addresses him as his father. Shanti demands explanation from Mishra and later, brings Golu home. Paro overhears Shanti and Sakina's conversation.

videos.title: Golu's Mother Arrives at the Mansion
videos.overview: Golu asserts his right on Mishra's house. Shanti throws Mishra out of her room and Masterji from the mansion. News about Golu is published in a newspaper, and Golu's mother Kamala visits the mansion.

videos.title: Shanti and Kamala Multiply Mishra's Woes
videos.overview: Kamala shows the evidence of her marriage with Mishra. Mishra unknowingly sleeps in Kamala's room and Shanti notices this. The next day, Kamala wears Shanti's saree and Mishra again makes a mistake.

videos.title: Kamala's Reality Comes to the Fore
videos.overview: Bittu and Pappu lodge a complaint against Mishra. Shanti and Kamala give the NOC to the police and both decide to live happily with Mishra. Later, Kamala tells Mishra the price of leaving him.

videos.title: Mishra Exposes Kamala
videos.overview: Mishra tells Shanti and Masterji Kamala's truth, but they do not believe it. Kamala tries to get Masterji's money. Mishra teaches Kamala a lesson, and she is exposed in front of everyone.

videos.title: Everyone Prepares to Face the Spirit
videos.overview: An elderly woman's words frighten the people of the mansion. Mishra and Mirza presume that Bittu and Pappu are planning to send someone to the mansion as a fake spirit. Later, they work on their plan.

videos.title: Bittu and Pappu Try to Exorcise the Spirit
videos.overview: To get rid of the spirit, Shanti and Sakina devise a plan against Bittu and Pappu. Bittu and Pappu fail to exorcise the spirit from the mansion. Later, their revelations scare everyone.

videos.title: The Spirit Holds Everyone Captive
videos.overview: Bittu decides to deal with the spirit. The people of the mansion build a relationship with the spirit. Bittu and Pappu try to leave, but it holds everyone hostage and makes Bittu and Pappu work.

videos.title: The Spirit's Decree for Everyone
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza call Sher Khan for help but he gets frightened of the spirit. The spirit asks everyone to sell the mansion and leave. Shanti and Sakina say that they will never sell the mansion.

videos.title: The Spirit Appears in Front of Everyone
videos.overview: Agent Vinod brings a man to show the mansion. Suddenly, the spirit of the mansion appears and he turns out to be Vinod's uncle. He tells everyone how Mirza and Mishra helped him get justice.

videos.title: The Doppelgangers of Mishra and Mirza
videos.overview: Bittu feeds bhang to Mishra and Mirza, who behave strangely the next day. It is revealed that Aashiq and Majnu have accidentally brought Mishra and Mirza's doppelgangers to the mansion in their place.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Arrive at the Mansion
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza arrive at the mansion and bear the brunt of the actions of their lookalikes, Haider and Suresh. Haider and Suresh fool Bittu. Later, the two of them visit Mishra and Mirza's shop.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Get Thrashed
videos.overview: Haider and Suresh steal money from Mishra and Mirza's shop. Mishra and Mirza again get thrashed due to Haider and Suresh's actions. Bittu threatens Mishra when he fails to return his money.

videos.title: Haider and Suresh Plan a Robbery
videos.overview: Suresh and Haider plan to rob the mansion. Sakina gets angry during Mirza and Suresh's exchange. Haider tries to get close to Shanti. Later, preparations for Mishra's and Mirza's anniversary begin.

videos.title: The Scam in the Mansion Is Exposed
videos.overview: Noor Jahan learns the truth about Haider and Suresh. Both try unsuccessfully to escape. At the party, the scam of the lookalikes comes to the fore, and Shanti and Sakina learn about the impostors.

videos.title: Bittu Hatches a Ploy to Usurp the Mansion
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza try their luck in the game of 'chausar' and fall for Bittu's ploy. Bittu plans to usurp the mansion along with winning 'chausar' to avenge his insult. Later, both work on the plan.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Fall for Bittu's Ploy
videos.overview: A disguised Shakuni and Bittu visit Mishra and Mirza. As planned, both of them lure Mishra and Mirza with an offer and ask them to play 'chausar'. Mishra and Mirza convince their family for this.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Play 'Chausar'
videos.overview: The Mishras and Mirzas send Masterji and Noor Jahan away from the mansion. The game of 'Chausar' begins and Mishra loses the mansion to Mirza. Mirza tells Mishra to vacate the mansion in three days.

videos.title: Bittu Usurps the Mansion
videos.overview: Bittu is happy to see that the Mishras are homeless. Later, Mirza falls for Bittu and Shakuni's ploy and loses the mansion in a game of 'chausar' with Bittu. The Mishras are happy to learn about this.

videos.title: Bittu Falls for Masterji's Ploy
videos.overview: Masterji and Noor Jahan return to the mansion. Bittu and Shakuni's true colours come to light. Masterji persuades Bittu to play 'chausar' with him. Bittu plays again putting the mansion at stake.

videos.title: Mishra Gets a Good News
videos.overview: Mishra learns about his maternal great grandfather Devi Prasad Mishra's investments. Dr Koodelal informs Bittu about this. Mirza and Sakina agree to help Mishra, but Bittu creates a new problem.

videos.title: The Mishras and Mirzas Change Their Identity
videos.overview: Harrowed by the wrongly printed Aadhar cards, Aashiq gives a suggestion to the Mishras and Mirzas to get money from the bank. They adopt each other's attire. Bittu learns about the mansion from Majnu.

videos.title: A Change in the People of the Mansion
videos.overview: The Mishras and Mirzas practice each other's language with Masterji and Noor Jahan's help after the bank manager's call. Later, the bank manager calls them to inform them about his expected arrival.

videos.title: Will Mishra and Mirza Get Exposed?
videos.overview: Bittu devises a plan against Mishra and Mirza. The people of the mansion put on an act in front of the bank manager and Adam Ali. Bittu tries to expose Mishra and Mirza.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza's Troubles
videos.overview: Bittu's plan against Mishra and Mirza gets foiled. Mishra and Mirza's difficulties increase when the bank managers Manav and Adam stay at the mansion. They make a revelation after the truth comes out.

videos.title: Nikki's Arrival Lands Mishra in Trouble
videos.overview: Shanti informs Mishra about Nikki's arrival and he fears that she will expose an old secret. After listening to Mirza, Mishra comes up with an idea. Later, Mishra arrives home posing as Happy Singh.
