videos.title: Will Mirza Locate Chintu?
videos.overview: Masterji lashes out at Mishra. Mirza tells Shanti that he has found a way to locate Chintu. Majnu fools Bittu again. Mishra steals Mirza's phone to hide his secret.

videos.title: Nikki Wishes to Marry Happy
videos.overview: Mirza brings a man named Chintu to the mansion. Nikki develops a misunderstanding because of Bittu. The next day, Nikki says that she is in love with Happy and Shanti decides to get them married.

videos.title: Mishra Tells Everyone the Truth
videos.overview: The Mishras and the Mirzas live in the same mansion, but both the families desire to gain complete ownership of the place, giving rise to hilarious situations.

videos.title: Will Sandra Get to the Mansion?
videos.overview: Mishra tells Mirza that the general's granddaughter, from whom he had leased the mansion for mental asylum, is coming. Bittu falls for Sandra. Mishra and Mirza try to keep her away from the mansion.

videos.title: Sandra's Arrival to Bring Problems
videos.overview: Bittu takes Sandra around Lucknow. He explains his plan to Mishra and Mirza. The duo tries to keep Bittu away from Sandra. Later, they learn that Sandra is about to visit the mansion.

videos.title: The Mansion Becomes a Mental Asylum
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza learn that Sandra is coming to the mansion. Mishra comes up with an idea and the mansion is turned into a mental asylum. Later, two lunatics from Agra arrive there.

videos.title: The Pretence to Trick Sandra
videos.overview: The people of the mansion put on an act in front of Sandra and Latkan. Sandra talks about taking the lunatics to Agra. Bittu's condition worries BBC. The people of the mansion learn the truth.

videos.title: Sandra Learns the Truth About the Mansion
videos.overview: Bittu exposes the people from the mansion in front of Sandra, who orders them to vacate the mansion in fifteen days. Sandra later tells Bittu that she will follow her old plan to acquire the mansion.

videos.title: Sandra Celebrates Her Victory
videos.overview: The people of the mansion protest against Sandra. Despite Shanti and Sakina's disapproval, Mishra and Mirza sign the papers. Sandra celebrates her victory, where things change unexpectedly.

videos.title: Karishma Arrives to Stay at the Mansion
videos.overview: At the bazaar, Shanti and Sakina meet Shanti's friend Karishma. Despite Mishra and Mirza's objection, Masterji rents out a room to Karishma. Later, she arrives to stay at the mansion.

videos.title: Karishma Struggles to Charm Mishra and Mirza
videos.overview: Karishma proposes to be friends with Mishra and Mirza. Bittu asks Mishra and Mirza to do a task for him. Karishma tries to charm Mishra and Mirza but things don't seem to work out.

videos.title: Karishma's Actions Scare Mishra and Mirza
videos.overview: Karishma invites Mishra and Mirza to her room by making an excuse and tries to charm them. Both inform their respective wives about it. Bittu professes his love to Karishma and gets thrashed for it.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Fall for Karishma
videos.overview: Karishma tells Shanti and Sakina that their husbands have fallen for her. They go the shop to find out the truth and question their husbands at night. Mishra and Mirza make a pact regarding Karishma.

videos.title: Shanti and Sakina's Misunderstanding Cleared
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina try unsuccessfully to oust Karishma from the mansion. Mishra and Mirza fight over Karishma. Shanti and Sakina take a big decision and Karishma reveals her true intentions.

videos.title: A Special Announcement Regarding Diwali
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza clean the mansion and Bittu tries to defame them. Later, both sweep the city due to the Swachh Lucknow Mission. The Cat Club makes a special announcement regarding Diwali.

videos.title: Diwali Preparations Begin at the Mansion
videos.overview: Masterji and Noor Jahan reminisce about the Diwali of their time. Shanti asks Mishra for a fridge and Sakina asks Mirza for a washing machine but a mishap occurs. Later, the Diwali preparations begin.

videos.title: BBC Reveals a Secret
videos.overview: BBC reveals a secret about the Diwali contest. The Dhanteras puja takes place in the mansion. Mishra and Mirza overhear two orphans' conversation. Bittu appeals for votes to win the contest.

videos.title: Diwali Celebrations with Orphaned Kids
videos.overview: The gifts brought by Mishra and Mirza upset their kids. The kids of an orphanage arrive to reveal the truth. Later, both the families celebrate Diwali and Zoya's birthday with the orphans.

videos.title: Who Will Win the Diwali Award?
videos.overview: The Mishras perform 'Govardhan Puja' on the next day of Diwali. The Cat Club chairperson reveals the name of the winner of the Diwali Award. Later, Mirza tells Mishra a thing about the Cat Club.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza's Decision
videos.overview: Mirza and Mishra go to scold Bittu's nephew, but his intelligence stuns them both. After hearing Bittu's taunts, they decide to focus on their children's studies.

videos.title: The Kids Plan For Rahul
videos.overview: The kids of the mansion land in trouble because of Bittu's nephew, Rahul. At the bazaar, Rahul's intelligence impresses Shanti and Sakina. The kids decide to invite Rahul to the mansion for a plan.

videos.title: The Kids Try to Intimidate Rahul
videos.overview: The kids of the mansion try to intimidate Rahul. Shanti asks her kids to wake up early for studies and even Sakina wakes up her kids early. The kids are asked to forget friends for studies.

videos.title: Noor Jahan's Suggestion to the Kids
videos.overview: Troubled by two tuitions, the kids share their grief with Masterji and Noor Jahan, who later talk to the Mirzas and Mishras about this. Zoya shares Noor Jahan's advice with the other kids.

videos.title: The Result of Pressurising the Kids
videos.overview: Sakina, Mirza, Shanti and Mishra prepare their kids vigorously and send them for the examination. However, the result shocks them all. Later, everyone realises their mistake.

videos.title: Mirza Misunderstands Sakina's Words
videos.overview: Sakina gives Mirza a good news but due to hearing issues, he misinterprets that Sakina is pregnant. One by one, everyone learns about this. Sakina feels strange after seeing Mirza's enthusiasm.

videos.title: Sakina Falls Prey to a Misunderstanding
videos.overview: Sabina and Mirza discuss the expected arrival of a little guest. Sakina overhears them talking on the phone and believes that they are having an affair. Later, she informs Shanti about this.

videos.title: Sakina Learns about Everyone's Misunderstandings
videos.overview: Sakina scolds Mirza after seeing her with Sabina. Later, Sakina learns about everyone's misunderstanding about her. However, she does not reveal the truth and lands herself in big trouble.

videos.title: Sakina Realises Her Mistake
videos.overview: Sakina pretends not to go to the hospital. After seeing everyone's excitement for the baby, Sakina realises her mistake and tries to tell the truth. The name of the child is discussed at Mirza's shop.

videos.title: Sakina Reveals the Truth about the Baby
videos.overview: Mirza decides to host a feast at the house to celebrate the news of the baby. Sakina feels guilty for lying. During the feast, she gets emotional on seeing Aashiq and Majnu’s gift and tells the truth.

videos.title: Mirza and Mishra’s Mission Nainital
videos.overview: Sakina and Shanti tell Mishra and Mirza to take them on a trip to the mountains. Mishra and Mirza learn that 11 members of a royal family have booked a stay in Nainital, and an idea strikes them.

videos.title: The Phoney Royals Reach Nainital
videos.overview: Except Kanta, the people of the haveli and others leave for Nainital masquerading as a royal family. Kanta plans to reveal the truth to the hotelier. Everyone enjoys the journey and reaches Nainital.

videos.title: The Phoney Royals Reach Hotel
videos.overview: Shanti, Sakina, Mishra, Mirza, and others are amazed by the beauty of Nainital when they wake up in the morning. Later, everyone arrives at the hotel. The phoney royal family introduces themselves.

videos.title: Are the Fake Royals going to be exposed?
videos.overview: Nikki asks everyone to choose a captain to prevent the fake royal family from getting exposed. Everyone starts arguing and complimenting each other's acting. They become nervous on seeing a waiter.

videos.title: Masterji Comes to the Rescue
videos.overview: A staff member reveals the truth about Mishra, Mirza and the others to the hotel’s manager. Mirza fails to salvage the situation. Due to Masterji, the fake royal family’s secret doesn’t get exposed.

videos.title: The Royal Family’s Reason to Visit Nainital
videos.overview: Mishra, Mirza and the others arrive at the market for some shopping. They learn that the Royal family was about to visit Nainital to plant 5000 trees. Nikki tells them how come out of this trouble.

videos.title: Everyone Enjoys Boating in Nainital
videos.overview: Bittu uses a trick to go boating with Nikki. Shanti and Sakina get their video shoot done while boating. Later, the hotel’s manager asks for their photo and questions them about planting trees.

videos.title: Mishra Sees a Bad Dream
videos.overview: Mishra, Mirza and the others get their photos clicked while planting trees. The manager sees the photos and tells Mishra and Mirza about the press conference. Later, Mishra sees a bad dream.

videos.title: The Fake Royal Family’s Press Conference
videos.overview: Bittu backs out of the press conference on seeing the police. Mishra, Mirza, Shanti and Sakina try to answer the media’s questions. Later, some villagers welcome them with song and dance.

videos.title: The Fake Royals Realise Their Mistake
videos.overview: The villagers conduct an entertaining show. The respect received from the villagers makes Mishra, Mirza and the others realise their mistake. Everyone decides to go back but Bittu makes a mistake.

videos.title: Mishra, Mirza and the Others Plant Trees
videos.overview: Mishra, Mirza and the others tell the manager the truth. Shanti and Sakina decide to plant five thousand trees and together they plant trees. They later make a decision to take care of all the plants.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza's Fight
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza quarrel over a petty matter. Shanti tells Mishra about Masterji on a call. Like Masterji, even the rest of the Mishras faint. Later, the reason for their unconsciousness is revealed.

videos.title: Mirza Takes Revenge on Mishra
videos.overview: Mirza learns about the toilet problem of the Mishras and takes revenge on Mishra. The Mishras suffer a lot due to the problem in the toilet. Bittu learns about the issues in the mansion.

videos.title: Mishra Controls the Family's Diet
videos.overview: Mishra asks the family members to eat less till the issue with the toilet is resolved. Bittu tries to feed Mishra samosas and suggests building a new toilet. Mirza orders pizza for the Mishra family.

videos.title: Mishra Gets a Chance to Take Revenge
videos.overview: Mishra fights with Mirza over sending pizza to his house. Mishra starts the work of constructing a toilet. He gets an opportunity to take revenge when Mirza's water pipeline breaks down.

videos.title: The Mirzas Face Water Shortage
videos.overview: Mishra does not connect Mirza's water pipeline to take revenge on him. Aashiq tells Mirza how difficult it is to get a new connection. The Mirza family faces a water shortage.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza's Reconciliation
videos.overview: Mirza collapses and Masterji helps him. Both the families realise that it is their loss in the fight. Masterji and Noor Jahan come forward and bring about a reconciliation between the two families.

videos.title: Adi Compares Mishra and Mirza
videos.overview: Adi gets impressed by Mirza and feels embarrassed on seeing Mishra. Mishra speaks bluntly during an argument with Masterji. Later, Adi does not want Mishra to accompany him to the PTA meeting.

videos.title: Adi Realises His Mistake
videos.overview: Adi tries a trick to avoid taking Mishra to school. He reveals the truth after being caught, which hurts Mishra. After an incident, Mishra apologises to Masterji and Adi also realises his mistake.

videos.title: The Couples' Role Reversal
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza taunt Shanti and Sakina as they don't have anything to do at home. The ladies then decide that they will manage the shop, while the husbands would manage the household.

videos.title: Shanti and Sakina's First Day at the Shop
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina arrive at the shop. Mishra and Mirza team up against their wives. Paro quits her job. Shanti and Sakina announce their order to Mishra and Mirza and both get into the kitchen.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Fail to Manage the House
videos.overview: The footfall of clients at the shop increases due to Shanti and Sakina. Mishra and Mirza's tricks to manage the house fail. Mirza asks Mishra to do something to get the wives back home from the shop.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Eve-Tease Their Wives
videos.overview: A disguised Mishra and Mirza eve-tease their wives to get them out of the shop, but get thrashed by the people. Frustrated with work, Aashiq and Majnu leave the job. Shanti and Sakina take charge.

videos.title: The Husbands vs Wives Fight Ends
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza try to take care of the house wholeheartedly. The issues in the business worry Shanti and Sakina. After an incident, Mishra, Mirza, Shanti and Sakina accept their mistake.

videos.title: The Fight during Christmas Celebration
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza dress as Santa at the Christmas party. Soon, their families start fighting. Masterji and Noor Jahan try to pacify them. Later, Mirza's sherwani gets damaged due to Mishra's mistake.

videos.title: Sakina Takes Revenge on Shanti
videos.overview: Mirza and Sakina ask Mishra to compensate for the loss and Shanti handles it. Sakina gives Shanti a hair trick to take revenge on her. Bittu plans the New Year's celebration at the mansion.

videos.title: Shanti's Spoilt Hair Angers Her
videos.overview: Shanti gets angry to see her spoilt hair and blames it on Sakina. Sakina pretends to cry and asks for punishment. Bittu tells Mishra that Sakina has intentionally spoiled Shanti's hair.

videos.title: Shanti Gets Mirza Thrashed
videos.overview: Shanti instigates Shabbir and he thrashes Mirza. However, even Mishra gets beaten up. Mirza is brought to the mansion and Shanti realises her mistake. Sakina decides to attack Shanti for this.

videos.title: A Competition between Shanti and Sakina
videos.overview: Bittu asks Shanti and Sakina to hold a competition of tolerance on New Year's eve. Later, Mishra and Mirza humiliate Shanti and Sakina to help them prepare for the competition.

videos.title: The 'Gustakhi Maaf' Competition
videos.overview: Sakina and Shanti intentionally insult each other in the 'Gustakhi Maaf' competition. Even Mishra and Mirza expose each other. Shanti and Sakina realise their mistake after an incident.

videos.title: The Feud in the Mirza family
videos.overview: Noor Jahan criticises the vegetables brought by Sakina. Later, both of them complain about each other over the phone to Mirza. Noor Jahan asks Mirza to choose between him and Sakina.

videos.title: Noor Jahan Comes to Live with the Mishras
videos.overview: At the behest of the Mishras, Noor Jahan comes to stay with them. Sakina doesn't like him praising Shanti, whose goodness lands her in trouble. Shanti later plans to reconcile Noor Jahan and Sakina.

videos.title: Noor Jahan Is Kind to the Mishras
videos.overview: Shanti and Mirza try to reconcile Sakina and Noor Jahan. Noor Jahan's health deteriorates due to her anger. She later gives jewellery to Shanti. Another act of her kindness is revealed by Mishra.

videos.title: Shanti Unveils the Plan
videos.overview: Shanti tells Sakina that Noor Jahan is under her control. Mirza decides to leave but Bittu comes and informs that Mishra and Shanti have taken Noor Jahan to a lawyer. Later, Shanti makes a revelation.

videos.title: Shanti’s Vow of Silence
videos.overview: Mishra tries to romance Shanti, but she gets irked with him. Bittu shares a remedy with Mishra to help solve his problem. However, Shanti learns about it and decides to take a vow of silence.

videos.title: Shanti's Silence Lands Mishra in Trouble
videos.overview: Shanti talks to the family members in sign language. Mirza tries the trick suggested by Bittu for Sakina, but his plan gets foiled. Later, Shanti's silence lands Mishra in trouble.

videos.title: Shanti Leaves the House
videos.overview: Mishra fails to trick the pizza delivery person. Bittu takes the pizza from Mishra by fooling him and sells it. Mishra gets angry with Shanti for Masterji and an upset Shanti leaves the house.

videos.title: Shanti Becomes Mauni Mata
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza look for Shanti. Bittu learns about Shanti leaving the mansion. Later, Shanti's new attire shocks everyone. Bittu tells them that Shanti has now become Mauni Mata.

videos.title: Mishra Apologises to Shanti
videos.overview: A group of devotees assemble in the court of Shanti, posing as Mauni Mata. Mishra gets terrified to learn that Shanti is taking 'samadhi'. Later, Bittu reveals his plan. Mishra apologises to Shanti.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza's Hospitality
videos.overview: Bittu tries to arrange money for his case. He visits the mansion with Dr Koode, BBC, and the rest for money and hospitality. Meanwhile, Shanti and Sakina get into an argument over garbage.

videos.title: Ruckus in the Mansion over Garbage
videos.overview: Bittu and the others get hurt due to the garbage. Sakina blames this on Shanti and a ruckus ensues. Bittu suggests fighting a legal battle over the matter and making the mansion a court.

videos.title: The Mansion Becomes a Court
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina do not reveal the truth to the family and worry about the case. A court is held in the mansion and the proceedings of the case begin. Shanti and Sakina present their case.

videos.title: Shanti and Sakina Bribe the Witnesses
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina bribe the witnesses and ask them to give false testimony in court. During the trial, they prove each other's witnesses to be false. The judge fines both and the trial proceeds.

videos.title: What Is the Outcome of the Case?
videos.overview: To win the case, Shanti, Mishra, Sakina and Mirza try unsuccessfully to bribe the judge. They later come up with a new trick but soon realise their mistake. The kids tell everyone the truth.

videos.title: The Condition to Hoist the Flag
videos.overview: Balkishan reveals the condition to let a person hoist the flag on 26th January. When the name of 3/13 comes up, he asks Mishra and Mirza for proof of their contribution to the freedom struggle.

videos.title: Bittu Creates a Rift between Mishra and Mirza
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza agree to hoist the flag together. Bittu decides to create a rift between them in order to hoist it. At Bittu's behest, Paro adds something to Shanti's tea, which hurts her throat.

videos.title: Mirza Becomes a Hero by Saving Aashiq
videos.overview: Bittu tries to impress Balkishan. To prove himself to be a good citizen in Balkishan's eyes, Mirza risks Aashiq's life and becomes a hero by saving him. Shanti asks Mishra to do something about it.

videos.title: Bittu Exposes Mishra and Mirza
videos.overview: Mishra, along with Majnu, devises a plan to prove himself a good citizen. Surprisingly, his plan works well. Later, Bittu exposes Mishra and Mirza in front of Balkishan.

videos.title: Bittu Realises His Mistake
videos.overview: Shanti's voice gets better. While going to hoist the flag, Bittu falls in the gutter, and Mishra and Mirza help him. Later, Bittu realises his mistake and admits to it in front of everyone.

videos.title: The Property Tax of the Mansion
videos.overview: The property taxes of INR 4 lakh each are levied on Mishra and Mirza, with a deadline of 15 days to pay. Both decide to participate in a wrestling match to arrange the money.

videos.title: Bittu's Suggestion to Mishra and Mirza
videos.overview: Bittu takes Mishra and Mirza for wrestling after seeing their fight. The next day, they visit Bittu. Bittu suggests Mishra and Mirza hire wrestlers to fight for them and takes money from them.

videos.title: Bittu Suggests a New Dangerous Trick
videos.overview: Paro overhears Bittu's words. Mishra and Mirza faint after learning about the escape of the wrestlers. Later, both confront Bittu, who tells them a trick to earn money by losing at a wrestling match.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza's State Shocks Everyone
videos.overview: After Mishra, Mirza gets thrashed by the wrestler. Their families are shocked to see their condition. Mishra and Mirza narrate the entire story to their families. Later, Shanti and Sakina meet Bittu.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Win a Wrestling Match
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina cannot bear to see Mishra and Mirza's state. Later, Mishra and Mirza wrestle in a pair and get thrashed, but the game takes an unexpected turn. Paro tells them both something.

videos.title: The Love and Care for Daughters-In-Law
videos.overview: Masterji gives Shanti a gift. Even Noor Jahan takes care of Sakina like a mother when she gets hurt. Shanti and Sakina ask Mishra and Mirza to fulfil Masterji and Noor Jahan's wishes.

videos.title: The Kids' Love Lands Masterji in Trouble
videos.overview: Shanti and Mishra fulfill Masterji's desire to become the emperor, which lands Masterji in trouble. Even Mirza and Sakina try to fulfill a wish of Noor Jahan by asking a close relative.

videos.title: Shanti and Sakina Plan Contradictory Events
videos.overview: Shanti decides to oragnise her mother-in-law's death anniversary. Sakina plans to celebrate Noor Jahan's birthday. Mishra and Mirza do not tell the date to each other and distribute the invitations.

videos.title: Invitations of Two Events Together Create a Stir
videos.overview: Mishra, Mirza, Shanti and Sakina prepare for their respective events. Bittu and Pappu work on their plan against them. Mishra and Mirza extend invitations to each other, which soon create a ruckus.

videos.title: Bittu's Plan Gets Foiled
videos.overview: Bittu and Pappu turn the people of the mansion on each other. Mishra and Mirza try to get each other's events cancelled. Later, they attend their respective events with their families in simplicity.

videos.title: Valentine's Day and the Terror of Choti Chor
videos.overview: Mishra, Mirza, and the rest discuss Choti Chor and Valentine’s Day. Bittu opposes Valentine’s Day. Shanti and Sakina plan to add romance to their marriage. The next day, Shanti’s look shocks everyone.

videos.title: Bittu and Pappu Come Under Suspicion
videos.overview: Bittu and Pappu stop people from celebrating Valentine’s Day. Sakina worries about her hair. Meanwhile, Misha and Mirza suspect Bittu and Pappu of being the Choti Chor.

videos.title: Sakina Falls Prey to the Choti Chor
videos.overview: Mirza gets shocked when Sakina’s hair gets cut. Shanti and Sakina try to discern if their husbands love them or their beauty. Later, the duo overhears Mirza and Mishra’s conversation.

videos.title: Bittu and Pappu Get Thrashed
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza tell the inspector that Bittu and Pappu are the Choti Chor. The inspector thrashes Bittu and Pappu. Noor Jahan’s hair gets cut as well. Shanti states that the Choti Chor is a witch.

videos.title: The Choti Chor Gets Caught
videos.overview: Mirza and Mishra convince Inaam to dress up as a girl. At night, the Choti Chor arrives and cuts Inaam’s hair. The Choti Chor gets caught due to a video clip and Mirza and Mishra teach him a lesson.

videos.title: A Thief Hides a Diamond in the Mansion
videos.overview: A thief steals a diamond from the museum and hides it in a vessel on the mansion’s terrace. The police advise Mishra and Mirza to stay alert. Later, Mirza and Mishra keep a watch on the terrace.

videos.title: The Thief Enters the Mansion as a Servant
videos.overview: To retrieve the diamond, the thief begins to work as a servant in Mishra’s house for free. When Shanti’s and Mishra’s actions become condescending, Mirza decides to drive away Mishra’s servant.

videos.title: The Thief Tries to Look for the Diamond
videos.overview: The Mishras get the servant, who’s actually a thief, to do the chores. The thief looks for the diamond. Mirza tells the thief to work at his house. Shanti and Mishra take care of the sick thief.

videos.title: The Thief Becomes Mirza's House Help
videos.overview: Bittu's words frighten the thief, who becomes Mirza's house help after learning that the diamond is in Mirza's area. Later, Bittu tells Mishra and Mirza that the diamond might be in the mansion.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Ask the Thief for a Share
videos.overview: The thief fails to flee with the diamond. Mishra and Mirza ask him for a share in it. Bittu comes there and recognises the thief. Later, the police come to the mansion and a revelation takes place.

videos.title: Shanti and Sakina Get the Credit Card
videos.overview: Everyone is shocked to see Bittu and Pappu and they tell about their credit card. Mishra and Mirza do not get the credit card. However, Shanti and Sakina get the card with Bittu's help.

videos.title: Masterji Objects to the Credit Cards
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina tell their husbands about their credit cards and they flatter them. Later, the two do a lot of shopping and Masterji objects to the use of credit cards.

videos.title: The Huge Credit Card Bills
videos.overview: Mirza and Mishra are saddened when everyone's credit card arrives, except theirs. Shanti buys a fridge, and Sakina buys a new TV. Later, Mirza and Mishra are shocked on getting the credit card bills.

videos.title: Shanti and Sakina Get Cheated
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina get a phone call and get cheated by the bank. After learning this, Mishra and Mirza get the shock of their lives. Later, even Bittu, who is ready to go to Goa, gets a setback.

videos.title: Mishra's Plan to Catch the Thug
videos.overview: Bittu, like everyone else, falls prey to fraud. Mishra plans to nab the thug. Shanti distracts the thug and invites him to someplace. The thug learns about the plan but still gets caught.

videos.title: The Secret of the Past Life
videos.overview: Sakina finds anklets under the ground. She tries to kill Mirza after wearing it. This shocks everyone in the mansion. Dr Koodelal says that this matter is related to her past life.

videos.title: Sakina's Past Life Story Comes to the Fore
videos.overview: Dr. Koodelal takes Sakina to her past life wherein Shanti and Sakina are dancers named Nimki and Ruafsana. Mishra and Mirza are Raja Chhannu and Nawab Gaffar, who are in love with Nimki and Ruafsana.

videos.title: BBC and Bittu's Past Life Deeds
videos.overview: In their previous lives, BBC and Bittu were Chimti and English officer Laddusan. Their past misdeeds come to the fore. At Laddusan's behest, Chimti turns Gaffur and Chhanu against Ruafsana and Nimki.

videos.title: Gaffar and Chhanu's Enmity
videos.overview: Masterji learns that he was an 'Aghori' in his past life. Gaffar and Chhannu mourn over Ruafsana and Nimki being unfaithful. Later, Gaffar and Chhannu try unsuccessfully to fight each other.

videos.title: Gaffar and Chhannu Learn the Truth
videos.overview: Gaffar and Chhannu learn about Laddusan's wrongdoing. They come to rescue Nimki and Ruafsana from Laddusan and find themselves in trouble. Nimki and Ruafsana rescue them and reveal their decision.

videos.title: Mirza and Mishra's Decision Regarding Holi
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza decide not to participate in the Holi celebrations. They even refuse to donate money for Holi to Pappu and Bittu. Later, no one agrees to be the chairman of the Holi committee.

videos.title: Shanti and Sakina Enjoy 'Lathmar Holi'
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina worry about Holi. Sakina suggests Shanti an idea to reconcile Mishra and Mirza during Holi. Later, both beat their husbands in the name of 'Lathmar Holi'.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza's Fight Upsets Everyone
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza fail to escape getting beaten. They later request their wives to go out somewhere. Bittu and Pappu stop them from getting into a scuffle. Masterji and Noor Jahan pacify them.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Take Part in 'Holika Dahan'
videos.overview: Preparations for 'Holika Dahan' begin. Mirza and Mishra forget to bring some important items. They take part in 'Holika Dahan' and Bittu reveals how he did it. However, they still remain angry.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Play Holi
videos.overview: Except for Mishra and Mirza, everyone else plays Holi and has fun. Bittu feeds them 'bhang' to get them to join the Holi celebrations. Later, both play Holi under the intoxication of 'bhang'.

videos.title: The Repair Work of the Mansion
videos.overview: Masterji gets injured due to the dilapidated condition of the mansion. To save money, Mishra and Mirza assign Bittu the work of repairing the mansion. Later, the Mishras come to live in Mirza's part.

videos.title: Living Together Proves Difficult for Both Families
videos.overview: Shanti and Mishra foil Mirza and Sakina's romantic plans. Living with the Mishras causes inconvenience to the Mirzas. Due to the deteriorating condition of the mansion, the problem gets worse.

videos.title: The Mishras and Mirzas to Stay on the Terrace
videos.overview: At Bittu's behest, the Mishras and Mirzas come to stay on the terrace. Meanwhile, Paro gets injured. Shanti and Sakina cook food on the stove. Mishra steals Mirza's mosquito net to avoid mosquitoes.

videos.title: People Stuck on the Terrace of the Mansion
videos.overview: Bittu breaks the stairs and everyone gets stuck on the terrace. He stops the repair work when Mishra and Mirza refuse to give more money and does not allow anyone else to do the work.

videos.title: The Mansion Begins to Shake
videos.overview: Bittu gives Mishra and Mirza a bad news. Later, the whole mansion starts to shake and everyone comes down from the terrace. Mishra's friend inspects the mansion and solves the problem.

videos.title: Shanti's Birthday
videos.overview: Mishra gives Shanti a birthday surprise. She asks him about Kishmish Nani's letter. The next day, everyone goes on a picnic. During a game, Rahul gets angry with Bittu for his actions.

videos.title: Rahul's Nexus with the Kids of Mansion
videos.overview: In reply to Kishmish Nani's letter, Shanti gives Mishra a letter. Rahul strikes a deal with the kids of the mansion and stays with them secretly. This worries Bittu. Zoya feeds food to Rahul.

videos.title: The Kids Blackmail Mishra
videos.overview: The kids keep Rahul away from Shanti's eyes but he falls into Mishra's hands. The kids blackmail Mishra to keep Rahul's secret. Later, Bittu and Pappu come to the mansion with the police.

videos.title: Bittu Goes on a Hunger Strike for Rahul
videos.overview: Mirza finds Rahul in the box and Zoya blackmails him to keep Rahul's secret. Later, at Mishra and Mirza's suggestion, Bittu goes on a hunger strike to bring Rahul back.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Reveal Their Secret
videos.overview: Bittu's condition worsens due to the fast. Bittu uses another way to bring Rahul back, and it works. Shanti takes everyone out for a picnic where Mishra and Mirza reveal their secret.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza to Play Carrom
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza ask the wives for permission to spend time at Bittu's carrom club. However, Shanti and Sakina flatly refuse. Due to this, Bittu insults Mishra and Mirza in front of everyone.

videos.title: Shanti and Sakina Suspect Their Husbands
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza try a trick against Shanti and Sakina, who allow them to go to the carrom club at Masterji and Noor Jahan's behest. Shanti and Sakina get suspicious as their husbands seem happy.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Wish to Watch a Film
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina spy on their husbands and feel satisfied. Paro tells Shanti and Sakina about her husbands' actions and gives a piece of advice. Mishra and Mirza seek help from Bittu to watch a film.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza to Watch a Movie
videos.overview: Bittu and Pappu lie to Shanti and Sakina to take Mishra and Mirza to watch a film. Shanti and Sakina allow them to go and decide to catch their husbands red-handed.

videos.title: Mirza and Mishra are Caught Red-Handed
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza go to watch a movie while Shanti and Sakina follow them. They catch them red-handed and beat them up. A misunderstood situation is exposed and they both realise their mistakes.

videos.title: Unexpected Guests Arrive at the Mansion
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza learn about Bittu and everyone else's struggle with homelessness. They request Mishra and Mirza for shelter in the mansion. Mishra and Mirza agree, and everyone comes to live there.

videos.title: The Guests' Real Motive Comes to the Fore
videos.overview: Mishra and Mishra request their wives to do the household chores for a few days. The mansion dwellers decide to oust the guests after learning about their real motive. Bittu plays the next trick.

videos.title: The Tenants Show Their True Colours
videos.overview: Mirza and Mishra try to trap Pappu and Bittu disguised as women. Later, the Mirzas and Mishras lash out at the tenants gambling in the mansion. The tenants start showing their true colours.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Face Trouble
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza blame each other and Masterji asks them to deal with the problem together. Meanwhile, Bittu tells Pappu the next plan. The ration cards of the tenants are received at the mansion.

videos.title: The Mansion Dwellers Leave the Mansion
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza get thrashed when they scold Bittu. They take a decision after Bittu reveals the truth. Later, the mansion dwellers leave from there. They get it back with Aashiq and Majnu's help.

videos.title: The Mansion Is at Stake
videos.overview: Bittu challenges Mishra and Mirza to a cricket match, and they accept his challenge. Bittu stakes his house, and Mishra and Mirza put the mansion at stake during the cricket match.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza's Actions Anger the Family
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza fail to tell their family about their actions. Aashiq and Majnu tell them something. The mansion dwellers learn of it being at stake. Mishra and Mirza's families get upset with them.

videos.title: The Mansion Dwellers Ready for a Cricket Match
videos.overview: Masterji asks Mishra and Mirza to refuse to accept the condition. The mansion dwellers accept Bittu's challenge due to his attitude and practice cricket. Aashiq and Majnu join them.

videos.title: Aashiq and Majnu Switch Allegiance
videos.overview: Bittu baits Aashiq and Majnu to join his team. Their exit upsets the haveli's residents. Masterji asks everyone to find their hidden talents, and Shanti and Sakina discover theirs.

videos.title: Bittu's Team Wins the Toss
videos.overview: Masterji makes his cricket team on the basis of everyone's skill. Mirza consoles Sakina that they will own the mansion. Shanti practices bowling at night. Later, Bittu's team wins the toss.

videos.title: The Mansion Dwellers' Batting Skills
videos.overview: Team Mansion bats first, and Masterji and Paro do well, but the rest are unable to perform. Due to the loss of wickets at a very fast pace, the team scores 122 runs.

videos.title: The Owners Save the Mansion
videos.overview: Bittu and Pappu make a good start, but Shanti and Sakina's performance changes the situation. The mansion dwellers manage to save the mansion. Later, Bittu makes a revelation in front of them.

videos.title: A Leopard Enters the City
videos.overview: Sakina tells Shanti about the arrival of a leopard in the city. Kanta tells everyone about his past. Bittu hinders the work of the police. Mishra and Mirza are locked in the shop because of a leopard.

videos.title: Mirza's Words Shock Mishra
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza, locked in the shop, argue with Majnu and Aashiq. When Mirza does not pick up the phone, Sakina calls Bittu and learns that he is in police custody. Mirza's words shock Mishra.

videos.title: Mishra and a Leopard's Face-Off
videos.overview: Mishra feels that a leopard has killed Masterji. He exits the shop and faces the leopard. Bittu and Pappu bring Masterji home. Masterji narrates his ordeal to everyone.

videos.title: Sakina Asks Mirza for the Moon
videos.overview: Everyone devises a plan to obtain Mirza's Zakat money. Sakina falls unconscious and everyone panics. Later, Sakina asks Mirza for the moon on the occassion of Eid.

videos.title: Shanti Asks Mishra for the Stars
videos.overview: Bittu and others promise to help Mirza in return for giving money for charity. Mirza's efforts to bring the moon anger Shanti and she asks him to bring her the stars.

videos.title: Will Mirza Get the Moon for Sakina?
videos.overview: Mishra gets into an argument with Mirza over his promise to bring the moon. Noorjahan refuses to pay Bittu, Pappu and others the donation amount. Bittu tells Mirza a trick to fool Sakina.

videos.title: Mishra Brings a Star for Shanti
videos.overview: Mishra brings a shooting star, shocking everyone. Later, Aadi and Mishra’s idea to bring the star is revealed. The inspector brings a scientist and Mishra ends up telling the truth to everyone.

videos.title: The Mansion Dwellers Celebrate Holi
videos.overview: Mirza and Mishra are saddened after Shanti and Sakina leave the house. Later, the two return, and Masterji and Noor Jahan reveal their plan. The entire family in the mansion celebrates Eid together.

videos.title: Bittu Bets with Mirza and Mishra
videos.overview: Mirza and Mishra tell Bittu that their wives are under their control. Bittu places a bet with both of them. He challenges Mirza and Mishra to get their wives to cook their favourite dishes.

videos.title: The Stubborn Mirza and Mishra
videos.overview: Mirza and Mishra ask their wives to cook their favorite dishes. When Sakina and Shanti refuse, both decide to stay out of the house. Their behaviour puts Masterji and Noor Jahan in a fix.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Stay Up All Night
videos.overview: Mirza and Mishra are unable to sleep outside the house. Their kids prank them. Shanti and Sakina decide to end the stubbornness of their husbands. Bittu thinks of a way to win the bet.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza's Health Deteriorates
videos.overview: Bittu tries to break Mishra and Mirza's hunger strike. Mishra and Mirza's health deteriorates. Bajrangi Sharma from Pati Samman Sanstha meets them. Bittu tells his plan to Aashiq, Majnu and others.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Faint
videos.overview: The problem of the mansion escalates, and Mishra and Mirza's condition worsens. Masterji and Noor Jahan pacify Shanti and Sakina. Everyone panics as Mishra and Mirza faint. The truth comes out later.

videos.title: A Rat Terror Starts in the Mansion
videos.overview: While Sakina finds her kurta torn, almonds go missing from Shanti's kitchen. Mishra becomes a laughing stock due to his pajama. Shanti goes to cut Sakina's clothes but only falls prey to the blame.

videos.title: Sakina and Mirza's Attempt to Steal Almonds
videos.overview: Shanti accuses Sakina of stealing almonds. Mishra tells Shanti the trick to catch the almonds thief. Sakina and Mirza attempt to steal almonds from Shanti, but are caught as thieves.

videos.title: A Camera Is Installed in Shanti's Kitchen
videos.overview: All the dishes in Mirza's tiffin are made of almonds, and Sakina teases Shanti. Shanti's almonds are stolen even after locking the kitchen. Later, Mishra gets a CCTV camera installed in the kitchen.

videos.title: Mishra's Trouble Goes to Mirza's Place
videos.overview: The mansion dwellers learn that a mouse is the almond thief. It runs into the Mirzas' part of the mansion when the Mishras try to drive it away. Later, Bittu and Pappu come to drive it away.

videos.title: The Rat in the Mansion Is Caught
videos.overview: Bittu and Pappu pretend to drive away the mouse. Mirza adds rat poison to the laddus, which is consumed by Noor Jahan. Later, Bittu suggests a trick to catch the rat, and it works.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Wish to Be Famous
videos.overview: Sakina asks Mirza to wipe the floor, and Bittu sees this. Bittu makes fun of Mirza, who realises that a famous person is always respected. Mishra and Mirza figure out a way to become famous.

videos.title: Mirza to Set a Local World Record
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza send their respective videos to set a world record. Later, Mirza explains his problem to Bittu, who asks him to set a local world record. Bittu introduces Mirza to Topi Lal.

videos.title: The Reason behind Mirza's Laughter
videos.overview: Everyone is surprised by Mirza's laughter but he refuses to divulge any information. Mirza's laughter starts to land him in trouble. Mishra learns that Mirza is trying to set a local world record.

videos.title: Mishra Starts Crying
videos.overview: Mishra lies to Sakina and she makes a pretense to stop Mirza's laughter. Later, Bittu suggests Mishra to set a local world record for crying. Everyone gets upset because of Mishra's crying.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Are Cheated
videos.overview: Sakina and Shanti hear that Mirza and Misha are set to achieve a local world record. The men's attitude changes after setting the record. It is revealed that the local world record company is fake.

videos.title: Mirza and Mishra Arrive to Buy Saris
videos.overview: Sakina and Shanti ask Mirza and Mishra to bring a Madhurima sari for them. Later, everyone discusses a popular TV serial. The next day, everyone lines up early in the morning to buy the sari.

videos.title: Mirza and Mishra Face Trouble
videos.overview: Mirza and Mishra fall asleep, and the sarees at the shop get sold out. Shanti and Sakina wait for their husbands. Mishra defeats Mirza in the competition and gets the saree from Bittu.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza's Conspiracy against Their Wives
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza cut the cable to stop their wives from watching the serial. Instead of improving, the situation further escaltes. Shanti and Sakina confront them after learning about their actions.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza's Video Creates a Ruckus
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina punish their husbands. Mishra and Mirza make videos to convey their message to Madhurima through social media. Paro shows it to Shanti and Sakina and the matter gets more serious.

videos.title: Mishra and Mirza Apologise to Madhurima
videos.overview: The mansion dwellers watch Madhurima's video. Shanti and Sakina ask Mishra and Mirza to apologise to Madhurima. Later, Madhurima comes to Lucknow, and Mishra and Mirza apologise to her.

videos.title: Mirza Recalls His Wedding Day
videos.overview: Mirza recalls the problems on his wedding day and taunts Sakina. Mishra asks Mirza to forget incidents from the past. Later, he tells everyone about Mirza's imperfect wedding.

videos.title: A Misunderstanding about Mirza's Decision
videos.overview: Mirza decides to marry Sakina again. Noor Jahan develops a misunderstanding after hearing them. One by one everyone learns that Mirza is going to do a second remarriage.

videos.title: Misconceptions about Marriage Are on the Rise
videos.overview: Everyone at the shop thinks that Mirza is marrying Sakina's maternal cousin Zebunisa. Inam tells the other kids that even Sakina is getting married. Shanti instigates Paro, who creates a ruckus.

videos.title: The Plan to Stop Mirza's Marriage
videos.overview: Shanti vows to stop Mirza's marriage. She meets Bittu, along with the rest, to seek help and Bittu suggests a plan to abduct Mirza. Later, Bittu and Pappu come to the mansion to abduct Mirza.

videos.title: Mirza Brings Home His Bride
videos.overview: As planned, Bittu renders Mirza unconscious and hides him. Mirza regains consciousness and learns about everyone's misunderstanding. To teach everyone a lesson, he brings his bride the next morning.

videos.title: The Teenage of Inam and Adi
videos.overview: Sakina and Shanti get magazines in Inam and Adi's bags. Both talk to their husbands about this. Later, Masterji brings Inam and Adi home to tell everyone their new act.

videos.title: Inam and Adi Insist on Getting a School Bus
videos.overview: Shanti punishes Mishra after he reveals his childhood love story. Inam and Adi insist on going to school by the school bus. Mirza and Mishra discover the real reason behind this and confront them.

videos.title: Mirza and Mishra Worry about Their Kids
videos.overview: Shanti and Sakina practice speaking English to talk to Adi and Inam's principal. Masterji gives a piece of advice to Mirza and Mishra. Later, Shanti and Sakina hear Inam and Adi reciting poetry.

videos.title: Adi and Inam Fight for a Girl
videos.overview: Bittu asks Mishra and Mirza to get Adi and Inam married. Adi and Inam fight over Juhi and their families question them. Bittu narrates his experience and gives Mishra and Mirza a suggestion.

videos.title: Adi and Inam Leave the Mansion
videos.overview: Adi and Inam are caught stealing money. Both leave the mansion after Shanti and Sakina get angry with them. Juhi's departure breaks Adi and Inam's hearts and Mishra and Mirza console them.

videos.title: Sakina Becomes the Mayor
videos.overview: Bittu becomes the Chief Councilor and says that he wants a lady Mayor in the city. Mishra and Mirza talk about it to Shanti and Sakina. Later, Bittu chooses Sakina to be the lady Mayor.

videos.title: Shanti and Sakina Teach Bittu a Lesson
videos.overview: Bittu and Pappu insult Sakina. Shanti defends Sakina and they teach Bittu and Pappu a lesson. Due to this, Bittu is removed from the position of chief councillor, and Sakina is appointed in his place.

videos.title: Bittu and Pappu to Take Revenge
videos.overview: Sakina ousts Pappu and makes Shanti the vice-councillor. Bittu and Pappu decide to take revenge. Shanti and Sakina get BBC fired and Dr Koode gets his clinic closed.

videos.title: Bittu Makes a Video of Shanti and Sakina
videos.overview: Mishra and Mirza realise that they made a mistake by sending their wives into politics. Shanti fights with Sakina, and Bittu makes their video. Later, Bittu and Pappu reveal their plan against them.

videos.title: Shanti and Sakina Quit Politics
videos.overview: Gopal Tiwari bribes Shanti and Sakina and later threatens them both. This frightens Mishra and Mirza. Shanti and Sakina apprise Masterji of the whole matter and decide to leave politics.

videos.title: Another Fight in the Mansion
videos.overview: The Mishras and Mirzas fight over non-vegetarian food. They agree to the fact that the mansion will belong to the one who pays INR 50 lakh first. Dr. Koode gives a suggestion to Mishra and Mirza.

videos.title: Bittu Reveals His Plan to Pappu
videos.overview: Mishra's kidney matches with Anthony's and Dr. Koode takes him along. Later, Mishra comes home without money. Bittu explains his plan to Pappu and takes the money to meet the Mirzas.

videos.title: An Idol Is Found in the Mansion
videos.overview: Bittu and Pappu execute the plan. The mansion dwellers learn about it. Bittu asks them to leave in two days. An idol is found in the mansion and a man from the archeology department comes there.

videos.title: A Box Is Found in the Excavation of the Mansion
videos.overview: Bittu suggests the mansion dwellers excavate it before the archeology department does it. Mishra and Mirza get upset, but later they excavate it together. A box is found during the excavation.

videos.title: The Mansion Papers are Found in the Box
videos.overview: Bittu, Pappu and the ladies of the mansion try to stop the archaeological officer. He suspects that something is found at the excavation of the mansion. A box opens and the mansion papers are found.
